name: Advanced Gutenberg Blocks
description: Addon content and media blocks for the Gutenberg editor.
project_description: Advanced Gutenberg Blocks is a Gutenberg blocks module for site builders and editors. It registers a set of extra client-side Gutenberg blocks (headings, text, media, sliders, mosaics, call-to-action, FAQ accordion, audio, spacer and more) so authors can compose richer content in the Gutenberg editor without custom block development. It ships no admin UI, routes, permissions, services or config; the blocks are declared in JavaScript and the module only adds two example server-side Twig templates and a preprocess hook for the demo 'example' block namespace.
